title: Control panel builds and pre-delivery quality
subtitle: Drawing interpretation, panel assembly, wiring, software loading, and quality checks in an industrial manufacturing environment.

image.alt: Open electrical control panel with internal wiring and industrial hardware

objective: Build, wire, load, and check industrial control panels from engineering drawings through pre-delivery quality assurance.
context: The work required precision at the component level while maintaining the broader delivery context: documented designs, repeatable build processes, quality expectations, and technician teamwork.
contribution: Interpreted panel designs and electrical schematics; assembled and wired control panels; loaded control-module software; completed pre-delivery QA; and resolved quality-control deficiencies before customer delivery.

decision.label: MANUFACTURING LESSON
decision.title: A panel is not complete when the last conductor is landed.
decision.text: The build also has to be checked against the documentation and prepared for the next person who will inspect, ship, install, or diagnose it. This perspective translates directly to serviceable product development.

results: Built, wired, loaded, and checked a sample of 30+ control panels across individual and team builds.
Processed 250+ PLC software updates in under half the allocated time while supporting panel production and QA.
